result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles, but I haven't run any tests or tried the command, so the `config.json` and `index.html` creation and the `-help` output are untested.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. I also added it to the no-argument usage overview, using the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. In that method, `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `analyzeLandscape` as the documented name and `updateLandscape` as the same command kept for existing scripts.

I didn't commit anything.
